title: Code for: Predictable but Mostly Mechanical: Survival Forecasts of Trend Reversals in Vietnamese Stocks
description: Data pipeline, models, evaluation and paper sources for a study of when price swings of Vietnamese stocks reverse. Swings are volatility-scaled directional-change swings of VN30 members (point in time) and listed banks, 2012-2026; reversal timing is forecast with landmark survival models and tested once, walk-forward, on 2017-2026. The repository holds the code, the dated decision log, the record of every run and the LaTeX sources; it contains no market data. All reported results come from frozen data snapshot 1f0c80b50427479e; research/paper1/COMMIT_MAP.md maps the commit ids recorded in the run folders to this repository. Data are available from the corresponding author on request, subject to the providers' terms.
